design: retrospective controlled reanalysis of original frozen predictions
budget: CAMP native sum of first requests
native_history: held fixed; no counterfactual retry/history replay
rq2_runtime: original fillna(0.0), retain all 5026 tasks; disclose 449 missing
scope: Reproduce only the W1 numerical comparisons reported in Sections IV and V of the eight-page editorial paper, from original frozen predictions. Original experiments are not retrained.
reported_comparisons: Access versus CAMP at equal total first requests, including recorded unused memory-time
Sizey versus CAMP at equal total first requests
Sizey versus CAMP at minimum 95% observed coverage
coverage_matching: Minimum empirical peak/request budget threshold covering ceil(0.95*N) tasks; one multiplier per method, applied to all requests.
